chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him) in the disparagement of the differences of the scholars in issuing fatwas.
[And in it, he disparages the people of opinion (ra'y) and entrusts the matter of judgment in religious affairs to the Quran.]
ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's view on the differences among jurists and the role of opinion versus the Quran in legal rulings?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the fragmentation of juristic authority, specifically condemning subjective opinion (ra'y) as a source of deviation. He elevates the Quran as the definitive, unambiguous standard for religious judgment, reflecting the Shia emphasis on returning to the primary text to avoid the distortions of later interpretive schools.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Amīr al-mu’minīn said in disparagement of the differences of view among the theologians.
